One piece of advice - be ready to adapt.  Change is the only constant, and things are changing faster than ever.  Keep expenses low and have a well funded emergency fund.  Cash on hand means you can take educated risk, which could lead to significant opportunities.  Outside of that, at your age it's impossible to know what the best path is.

The biggest piece of advice I followed at a young age was "live below your means". Maybe housing is shared with a few roommates; that car is a used and well maintained car, rather than a new car, learn to cook simple meals, rather than constantly eating out. Budget to see where cash is coming in and going out. Don't use a credit card unless you can pay it off in full when the bill comes in.
